functions with fixed output size.

This trait wraps [`Update`], [`FixedOutput`], [`Default`], and
[`HashMarker`] traits and provides additional convenience methods.

461.name: digest
461.docs:
This crate provides traits which describe functionality of cryptographic hash
functions and Message Authentication algorithms.

Traits in this repository are organized into the following levels:

329.name: core_api
329.docs:
Low-level traits operating on blocks and wrappers around them.

Usage of traits in this module in user code is discouraged. Instead use
core algorithm wrapped by the wrapper types, which implement the
higher-level traits.

4.name: CtVariableCoreWrapper
4.docs:
Wrapper around [`VariableOutputCore`] which selects output size
at compile time.

102.name: RtVariableCoreWrapper
102.docs:
Wrapper around [`VariableOutputCore`] which selects output size
at run time.

245.name: CoreProxy
245.docs: A proxy trait to a core type implemented by [`CoreWrapper`]

154.name: CoreWrapper
154.docs:
Wrapper around [`BufferKindUser`].

It handles data buffering and implements the slice-based traits.

232.name: XofReaderCoreWrapper
232.docs:
Wrapper around [`XofReaderCore`] implementations.

It handles data buffering and implements the mid-level traits.

83.name: Buffer
83.docs: Buffer type used by type which implements [`BufferKindUser`].

76.name: UpdateCore
76.docs: Types which consume data in blocks.

86.name: FixedOutputCore
86.docs: Core trait for hash functions with fixed output size.

233.name: ExtendableOutputCore
233.docs: Core trait for hash functions with extendable (XOF) output size.

250.name: XofReaderCore
250.docs: Core reader trait for extendable-output function (XOF) result.

3.name: VariableOutputCore
3.docs:
Core trait for hash functions with variable output size.

Maximum output size is equal to [`OutputSizeUser::OutputSize`].
Users are expected to truncate result returned by the
[`finalize_variable_core`] to `output_size` passed to the [`new`] method
during construction. Truncation side is defined by the [`TRUNC_SIDE`]
associated constant.

300.name: TruncSide
300.docs:
Type which used for defining truncation side in the [`VariableOutputCore`]
trait.

190.name: DynDigest
190.docs: Modification of the [`Digest`] trait suitable for trait objects.

70.name: HashMarker
70.docs: Marker trait for cryptographic hash functions.

128.name: Update
128.docs: Types which consume data with byte granularity.

179.name: FixedOutput
179.docs: Trait for hash functions with fixed-size output.

173.name: FixedOutputReset
173.docs: Trait for hash functions with fixed-size output able to reset themselves.

277.name: XofReader
277.docs:
Trait for reader types which are used to extract extendable output
from a XOF (extendable-output function) result.

235.name: ExtendableOutput
235.docs: Trait for hash functions with extendable-output (XOF).

239.name: ExtendableOutputReset
239.docs: Trait for hash functions with extendable-output (XOF) able to reset themselves.

136.name: VariableOutput
136.docs: Trait for hash functions with variable-size output.

139.name: VariableOutputReset
139.docs: Trait for hash functions with variable-size output able to reset themselves.
